Hi all — thanks for the context, Bethany. I've kicked off an intake checklist and a first-pass set of redline notes. A few items we need to confirm before I send a redline:

1) SOC 2 / security evidence: Please confirm the SOC availability window (latest report date) and whether the environment will be single-tenant (Dedicated) or multi-tenant (Hosted). That affects our data residency language.

2) Signatory authority: Who at Acme will sign the MSA? If it's an agent in procurement, can you provide the name and email? We may need a corporate signatory on the Order Form.

3) Billing & seat counts: Marissa, can you confirm which pricing tier we're mapping and whether Acme expects annual or monthly billing? Bethany indicated procurement@acmeanalytics.com is billing contact. Also: will seat counts be firm at signature or can we treat them as an estimate with adjustments?

4) SLA exceptions: Bethany, you mentioned a possible SLA change — please outline the specific SLA deviation (latency targets, uptime % or credits) so I can assess. Anything outside our standard template may require legal escalation.

Action items I'm taking this afternoon:
- Attach redline_tracker.xlsx (first-pass comments) — I'll post to the Drive and add line-item flags (exec review / pricing ask).
- Prepare a clean MSA+OrderForm draft with tracked changes and a summary cover note.
